title: A JoLT for the KV cache: Near-Lossless KV Cache Compression via Joint Rank-bit Allocation
summary: The key-value (KV) cache is the dominant memory bottleneck in long-context language model inference. Existing compression methods apply low-rank factorization or quantization independently, without jointly allocating rank and precision under a shared storage budget. We introduce JoLT, a training-free compressor that treats grouped prefill caches as fourth-order tensors and applies partial Tucker decomposition along the token and feature modes, the two axes that carry low-rank structure, while leaving the head and layer modes intact.
